posts.caption:
Ordering for eight people without the chaos. A short guide.

1. One person holds the menu.
2. Pick the sharing plates first.
3. See the portion before you order.
4. Order one extra, not five.
5. Show the waiter one list.

Save it for the next birthday dinner. Send it to the group chat.

For restaurant owners and managers in Lahore.

Your menu talks to every guest, every night, and most of the time it is just text. MENVA puts your real dishes on the guest's table, in 3D and at true size, straight from the table QR. No app for them to download.

posts.caption:
How MENVA works, in three steps.

1. Scan the code on your table. The menu opens on your phone. No app.
2. Tap a dish. The real dish comes into focus. Turn it with a finger.
3. See it on your table. Place it in front of you at its true size, then decide.

Teen step. Bas.

posts.caption:
How a dish becomes a 3D scan.

1. The real plate is photographed from every angle.
2. Those photos are rebuilt into a 3D model.
3. We clean it, check its size and make it light enough for restaurant wifi.
4. It goes on the menu, behind the table QR.

No AI-generated food. What you see is what was served.
posts.alt: Carousel explaining how a dish becomes a 3D scan.

slides.b: From every angle, all the way around.
The photos become one model you can turn.
Checked, cleaned and small enough for restaurant wifi.
Behind the QR. No AI food, ever.

True size means true size. In AR you cannot pinch the dish bigger or smaller. What you see on your table is the portion you get.

posts.alt: A phone showing a real dish placed on a table at true size.

slides.b: What lands on your table is the portion you get.
